name: Crain Orso'an
source:
Crain Orso’an is an engineer and mechanic who works for the FOEs. His love for machines surpasses all else in his life, and he is much more interested in them than other people. For this reason, he can often come across as anti-social.

[From [url=http://woodsy-studio.com/QC/veramus/]official site[/url]]
